integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof, two dependency-free verification programs and captured outputs. Finite tests corroborate rather than certify the infinite theorem. No outside independent mathematical validation performed.
limitations: Exact ordinary square-factor classification only for binary circular words with precisely three ones; no unrestricted square extremum or higher-weight result. Limit distribution given as a Dirichlet pushforward, without closed density. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed work.
title: Exact square spectra of three-marker binary circular words and a five-ninths law
